sources.title: Privacy Act 2020
sources.controlled_reference: New Zealand Public Act 2020 No 31, section 22
sources.issuer: New Zealand Parliament; official version published by the Parliamentary Counsel Office
sources.scope_notes: New Zealand privacy obligations across sectors; not limited to insurance or a Northwind product.
sources.usage_boundary: May support privacy-purpose, notification, security, use, and disclosure explanations. It cannot answer coverage, liability, fraud, approval, or Northwind procedure questions.
known_limitations: This inventory is not legal advice and does not select an exception to an information privacy principle.
The source is legislation, not Northwind policy or proof of a Northwind operational process.
The latest official version must be rechecked at ingestion and before publication.

sections.intended_use: Bound collection, notice, security, use, and disclosure when designing claimant-authorised external-service data sharing.

sources.title: Fair Insurance Code 2020
sources.controlled_reference: Insurance Council of New Zealand, Fair Insurance Code 2020
sources.scope_notes: ICNZ members; general insurance other than health and life; individuals and entities with 19 or fewer employees.
sources.usage_boundary: May support general conduct, communication, claim-handling, confidentiality, and third-party coordination guidance. It cannot establish Northwind membership, policy wording, coverage, or a claim decision.
known_limitations: Northwind membership of ICNZ has not been verified, so the code is not labelled as Northwind policy.
The code is an industry code rather than legislation or customer-specific policy wording.
Applicability to a product and effective period must be checked before a passage is retrieved.

sections.section_path: Our general responsibilities to you / clauses 1-14
sections.intended_use: Support plain communication and privacy-aware handling without turning the code into claim authority.

sections.section_path: What happens when you make a claim / clauses 16-20
sections.intended_use: Support claimant-facing process explanations and permission-aware coordination with assessors or repairers.

sources.title: Insurance
sources.controlled_reference: New Zealand Consumer Protection, Insurance guidance page
sources.scope_notes: Public New Zealand consumer guidance across insurance types, including motor vehicle insurance.
sources.usage_boundary: May support general consumer process explanations and signposting. It cannot determine a customer's policy terms, Northwind process, coverage, excess, acceptance, or refusal.
known_limitations: The web page has no stable document edition, so retrieval date is used as the controlled version.
The page is general guidance and is not Northwind policy or customer-specific advice.
Statements that depend on policy wording or current law require the authoritative underlying source.

sections.intended_use: Support a general explanation that claim information should be relevant, complete, and kept distinct from a coverage conclusion.
